data: Apple reported diluted earnings per share of $6.08 for fiscal 2024 (the year ended September 28, 2024), compared with $6.13 for fiscal 2023, a decline of about 0.8%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $93.74 billion, down roughly 3.4% from $97.00 billion in fiscal 2023. The decrease was driven mainly by a one-time income tax charge of about $10.2 billion tied to the European Commission's State Aid ruling on Ireland. Excluding that charge, diluted EPS would have been about $6.75, which would have represented growth of roughly 10% over fiscal 2023.
